listing.name: Interesting Portraits Pack
listing.summary: This pack has 345 375 portraits. All have been modified to fit the various factions or Starsector's aesthetic in general. All portraits are exclusive to each faction. I wanted to keep it immersive and complement the portraits that are already ingame.
listing.aiSummary: Adds 375 faction-exclusive portraits modified to fit the game's aesthetic.

description:
I found out about this game from SsethTzeentach and I wanted to repay the devs and community for allowing people to try before you buy.
This pack has 345 375 portraits. All have been modified to fit the various factions or Starsector's aesthetic in general. All portraits are exclusive to each faction. I wanted to keep it immersive and complement the portraits that are already ingame.

This mod also fixes the stunning lack of shoulder birds, a necessity for ship's captains in any era.
It took a long time and lot of work, but I learned a lot and I'm happy with the result. Enjoy!

Download: https://www.dropbox.com/s/a5ipzo852ifohu0/Interesting%20Portraits%20Pack.rar?dl=0

I give permission for anybody to use these for their own mods. My only request is credit and a link back to this thread so people know where they came from.
